verdict.rationale: Luma's own docs show natural-language prompts driving generation and Luma Agents running multi-step research, generation and refinement workflows, so the product can be steered conversationally. The evidence covers generation tasks only, not operating the product as a whole, and nothing shows how far agent commands reach. missing for 10: documented natural-language control of product operations beyond generation (e.g., managing projects, settings, or edits via commands), detailed docs on the Luma Agents command interface, and independent hands-on corroboration of agent-driven operation.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands

citations.quote: Agents research, generate, and refine across video, image, audio, and text, and your brand holds steady through all of it.
Luma Agents for multi-step video and image workflows
Messy or chained prompts work natively. No middleware or prompt engineering required.
One reasoning endpoint. One generation endpoint. The model thinks before it ships, so the first pass is usually the right one.
